column3: I'm building a Next.js admin dashboard. Build a page with a table showing customer orders (order id, customer name, total, status). We don't have the backend API yet, but I want it ready to plug in later without rewriting the page.
Add a product grid to the storefront homepage — image, name, price, add-to-cart button, maybe 12-20 products. Backend isn't ready, just use placeholder data for now but make it swappable later.
Build a settings page with a list of team members (name, email, role) that I can remove people from.
Scaffold the invoices list page in our React app. The API isn't built yet but I want to be able to hook it up later without touching the components.
Make a dashboard with KPI cards and a recent-activity feed using fake data for now. Backend comes next sprint.
Create the signup form UI. The endpoint doesn't exist yet, so mock it, and I want to swap in the real one easily.
Fix the typo "recieve" in the footer.
Make the hero background darker and the headline bigger.
Add rate limiting to the Express login route.
What does the useMemo hook do in Header.tsx?
Write a Prisma migration that adds a status column to orders.
Build a marketing landing page for a coffee shop with scroll animations. All the copy is already written.
Our product list page is crashing in production with "cannot read properties of undefined". Find the bug.
